bb.name: Сторож лимитов_vibecom
bb.description: Two guards, each with its own switch and thresholds. Claude Code (on by default): at 85 % of the weekly Claude limit every claude-code thread moves to Sonnet xhigh and turns on Opus are held and re-queued on Sonnet; at 93 % claude-code work stops until `bb limit-guard resume`. Codex (off by default, `bb limit-guard on codex`): the same on the weekly Codex limit, stage 1 lowers the effort (or moves to a model set in the settings). After the weekly reset the previous models come back. Budgets (on by default): a weekly limit in money for Pi threads per provider — Gemini on google-vertex/* in dollars, Yandex (yandex/*) and Cloud.ru (cloudru/*) in rubles — counted from Pi's session files by catalog prices; the week starts Monday 00:00 Moscow time; 80 % — a warning, 100 % — Gemini turns wait and running ones stop until `bb limit-guard resume gemini|yandex|cloudru`; `bb limit-guard limit gemini|yandex|cloudru <amount>`.
